gen-gf-gugi-gf-hind-vadodara: Distinctive from the first glance, Gugi towers with lowercase that nearly reaches its capitals. Hind Vadodara, a sans-serif with rounded bowls and generous gaps, gives that boldness somewhere to rest.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-huninn: Huninn reads modern and tidy, its lowercase rising close to cap height. Gugi's cut-open terminals and tall letters add the loud, display-sized personality that Huninn's sans text happily stays out of the way of.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-inter-tight: Inter Tight is a modern sans with short ascenders and curve tails held back from the body. Inter Tight keeps its reserve beside Gugi, whose tall lowercase and open-cut terminals carry all the display swagger.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-karla: Karla, a plain sans with a gaping c opening and a middle band so tall the line looks stocky, sits under Gugi's monoline skeleton. Their shared generosity of shape is what ties them.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-kedebideri: Kedebideri is a sans with a skyward x-height and rounded, inviting letters. Gugi's uniform stroke thickness gives the heading its punch, and Kedebideri's softer curves are the natural counterweight.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-khula: Gugi ends its terminals at the same width they began, giving headings a clean, cut-glass bold look. Khula is the quieter half, a sans with a tall midsection and curves that hold their mouths open.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-krub: Glass-tube lettering, hollow and constant in thickness, is what Gugi brings to the top. Krub, a sans with a pronounced x-height and pen-lifted curves, adds a looser, more contemporary hand underneath.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-kufam: Contemporary, with a neon-tube feel in every line, Gugi and Kufam share a single track width. Kufam, a plain sans, lets its generously open e curves and dominant lowercase bodies sit comfortably below Gugi's louder heading.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-lexend: Gugi's tall lowercase nearly climbs to the capitals. Lexend answers with outsized lowercase proportions and open jaws on every curve, so both fonts feel generous in scale, one loud and one friendly.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-lexend-deca: Bold, tall and cut open, Gugi makes a loud first impression at the top of the page. Lexend Deca, a plain sans with an unshaded line and big lowercase, keeps the text beneath it friendly and unfussy.
